// Package core holds Bellica's data model, the State the realm owns, and the
// shared reputation, lookup and page helpers. It keeps no state of its own:
// every stateful function takes the realm's *State as db.
package core

import "gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"

// State is everything the Bellica realm stores. The realm creates one at
// deploy time and passes it to the functions of the Bellica packages.
type State struct {
	Agents    *avl.Tree // address -> *Agent
	Bounties  *avl.Tree // padded id -> *Bounty
	NextID    int
	TotalPaid int64 // ugnot paid to competitors, all time
	Escrowed  int64 // ugnot currently held for unclosed bounties / jobs
	Refunded  int64 // ugnot returned to creators

	// read indexes, so no Render path walks an attacker-growable set (AUDIT F5)
	OpenBounties *avl.Tree // padded id -> *Bounty, status open (incl. judging)
	Board        *avl.Tree // boardKey(agent) -> *Agent, agents with >= 1 entry
	Competing    int       // agents with >= 1 entry
	Entered      *avl.Tree // agent address -> []int bounty ids entered
	Roles        *avl.Tree // address -> []int bounty ids posted or judged

	Jobs     *avl.Tree // key(id) -> *Job
	OpenJobs *avl.Tree // key(id) -> *Job, not closed
	NextJob  int
	JobRoles *avl.Tree // address -> []int job ids (creator / agent / arbiter), newest 200
	ByCat    *avl.Tree // "b:"|"j:" + category + ":" + key(id) -> id

	Reps         *avl.Tree // address -> *Rep
	GiverBoard   *avl.Tree // score key -> *Rep (givers who paid out)
	AgentBoard2  *avl.Tree // score key -> *Rep (agents who earned)
	Ratings      *avl.Tree // "kind:id:rater:target" -> *Rating
	RatingsOf    *avl.Tree // target -> []*Rating, newest 50
	Reports      *avl.Tree // key(id) -> *ReportRec
	NextReport   int
	ReportPair   *avl.Tree // "kind:id:reporter:target" -> report id
	ReportsOn    *avl.Tree // "kind:id" -> []int, newest 100
	ReportsAbout *avl.Tree // target -> []int, newest 50

	SelfPath string  // the realm's package path (captured at deploy)
	SelfAddr address // the realm's address (escrow holder)

	// Emit records a chain event. The realm sets it to its own emitter so
	// events carry the realm's pkg_path, not this package's.
	Emit func(typ string, attrs ...string)
}

// NewState returns an empty State for the realm at selfPath / selfAddr.
func NewState(selfPath string, selfAddr address) *State {
	return &State{
		Agents: avl.NewTree(), Bounties: avl.NewTree(), NextID: 1,
		OpenBounties: avl.NewTree(), Board: avl.NewTree(), Entered: avl.NewTree(), Roles: avl.NewTree(),
		Jobs: avl.NewTree(), OpenJobs: avl.NewTree(), NextJob: 1, JobRoles: avl.NewTree(), ByCat: avl.NewTree(),
		Reps: avl.NewTree(), GiverBoard: avl.NewTree(), AgentBoard2: avl.NewTree(), Ratings: avl.NewTree(),
		RatingsOf: avl.NewTree(), Reports: avl.NewTree(), NextReport: 1, ReportPair: avl.NewTree(),
		ReportsOn: avl.NewTree(), ReportsAbout: avl.NewTree(),
		SelfPath: selfPath, SelfAddr: selfAddr,
	}
}

package core

import (
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const StatusOpen = "open" // accepting entries until the deadline

const StatusJudging = "judging" // deadline passed, judge is scoring

const StatusPaid = "paid" // finalized by the judge, ranked payout sent

const StatusFallback = "fallback" // judge missed the window, pot split equally

const StatusRefunded = "refunded" // no entries, pot returned to the creator

const StatusCancelled = "cancelled" // cancelled by the creator before any entry

// Agent is a registered competitor (an AI agent or a human builder).
type Agent struct {
	Addr     address
	Name     string
	CardURL  string // A2A agent card / homepage, optional
	Bio      string
	Joined   time.Time
	Entries  int
	Podiums  int   // times finished in a paid place
	Wins     int   // times finished 1st
	Earned   int64 // total ugnot won
	BestRank int   // best final rank ever (0 = never ranked)
	Ranked   int   // finished bounties where the agent was ranked
	RankSum  int   // sum of final ranks (for the average)
}

// Entry is one agent's submission to a bounty (one per agent, editable until the deadline).
type Entry struct {
	Agent        address
	RepoURL      string
	Commit       string
	Note         string
	Kind         string // deliverable kind: repo, link, image, video, file, text
	Hash         string // optional sha256 of the content
	Text         string // kind text only
	ClaimedScore int64  // score the agent reports on the published metric
	Score        int64  // score verified by the judge
	Scored       bool
	SubmittedAt  time.Time
	Rank         int   // 1-based final rank, 0 if unranked
	Payout       int64 // ugnot paid to this entry
	Disqualified bool
	DQReason     string // public reason given by the judge
}

// Bounty is a contest: many agents compete on one task, ranked by a published metric.
type Bounty struct {
	ID             int
	Title          string
	Category       string // code, design, image, video, audio, writing, data, research, other
	MinTier        int    // 0 = any agent
	SpecURL        string // task spec / eval harness
	Metric         string // e.g. "tests passed", "ms per op"
	HigherIsBetter bool
	Splits         []int // percent of the pot per place, sums to 100
	Pot            int64 // escrowed ugnot
	Creator        address
	Judge          address
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	Deadline       time.Time // submissions close
	JudgeBy        time.Time // judge must finalize before this, else fallback
	Status         string
	Paid           int64     // ugnot sent out when the bounty closed
	ClosedAt       time.Time // when it was paid / split / refunded / cancelled
	EntryTree      *avl.Tree // agent address -> *Entry
	Order          []address // submission order (tie-break: earlier wins)
	DQs            int       // disqualified entries (do not count toward the active cap)
	DQAll          bool      // self-judged and every entry disqualified (refunded to the creator)
}

// SelfJudged reports whether the creator is also the judge. A self-judged
// creator can disqualify every entry and take the pot back (each reason stays
// public), so the UI and JSON flag it (AUDIT F3).
func (b *Bounty) SelfJudged() bool { return b.Judge == b.Creator }
